path_convention: All asset_path and metadata_path values are relative to this manifest. Event IDs are case-sensitive. Each reuse node points to the same existing PNG without a duplicate file.
image_policy: Original PNG bytes preserved exactly; files were renamed by event/stat key for portability. No image was regenerated, resized, re-encoded, or edited for this handover.
integration_status: Assets and manifests only. No game source, Yarn, scene, prefab, or runtime assignment changes are included.
